items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Later on, when you were leading the quintet with Harold Land, you had a variety of pianists in that group: Chick Corea, Stanley Cowell, Joe Sample.

ctx.x: We did that album. We did – Herbie was on that Solo/Quartet album. That was a different album, the Solo/Quartet with McCoy.
Later on, when you were leading the quintet with Harold Land, you had a variety of pianists in that group: Chick Corea, Stanley Cowell, Joe Sample. Talk a little bit about any of those gentlemen?

Joe Sample was first, I think. We did a few things with Joe. He was – the Crusaders were starting to get really big in L.A. But Joe had – we always enjoyed playing with Joe. Joe was a lot of fun. But the group was starting to develop a different way of playing, longer melodies and stuff. Stanley – Chick came in right before he went with Miles, I think. It started to be this long-type groove.
